study: Asymmetric O-H stretch of H2O, STO-3G, frozen-core CAS(8e,6o)

figures.title: Asymmetric O–H stretch: reference and VQE energies
figures.caption: R₂ = 1.8, 2.2, and 2.6 Å. Energies are total electronic plus nuclear-repulsion values from the saved scan.

figures.title: Correlation recovery along the asymmetric stretch
figures.caption: Three geometry points only. No values between the sampled geometries are inferred.

figures.title: Accuracy–entangling-resource trade-off
figures.caption: CX counts are level-3 transpiler estimates. Min–max spans two starts (n=2), not a confidence interval.

figures.title: Circuit-resource growth with paired-ansatz repetitions
figures.caption: Counts are from the recorded level-3 compilation of the logical circuit, not hardware-routed execution.

figures.title: Observed restart-to-restart variability
figures.caption: Two starts per configuration only (n=2); observed range is not a confidence interval or a global-minimum guarantee.

figures.title: Optimization traces under a fixed evaluation cap
figures.caption: The pilot used a 150-objective-evaluation cap. Gradient evaluations and wall-clock cost are not represented by this x-axis.

figures.title: Held-out optimizer outcomes for PUCCSD(1)
figures.caption: Ten starts per optimizer. Results use ideal statevector objectives; evaluation count is not equal to wall-clock or hardware cost.

figures.title: Optimizer convergence at common evaluation checkpoints
figures.caption: Objective evaluations are a budget proxy. Exact gradients, their cost, and elapsed time differ across optimizers.

figures.title: SPSA calibration grid: development-stage results
figures.caption: Tuning data only, not held-out performance. The selected auto-calibration schedule is run-dependent.

figures.title: Fermionic ADAPT-VQE: progress through the interrupted run
figures.caption: The run stopped after 11 of 16 requested cycles. Final recorded error: 3.473 mHa vs active-space CASCI; chemical accuracy was not reached.

figures.title: Low-shot synthetic noise: uncertainty overwhelms the ideal error
figures.caption: PUCCSD(1), 10 mapped qubits; 4,416 shots total. Synthetic noise p₁=10⁻⁴, p₂=10⁻³, symmetric readout flip=1%. Noisy estimate error +789.3 mHa ±570.4 mHa (one propagated sampling SE, one seed); this is too imprecise to support a chemical-accuracy claim.
